choice_basis: Rows are [preference points, applicants, drawn]. Iowa publishes only the number of SUCCESSFUL applicants at each point level plus total applications per zone/season, so applicants per point level are null; total applications are in 'apps'. Row with points 7 means 7+.

sources.label: Iowa DNR 2026 nonresident deer drawing statistics (PDF)

notes: Nonresident-only draw; residents buy deer licenses over the counter, so res is null.
Applicants who bought points only are excluded from the statistics.
Gun season licenses: 2026 quota totals 3,901 drawn; bow licenses capped at 35% of each zone's 6,000-license general quota.
Zone 3 gun had 2 licenses left after the draw (sold as excess from July 25).
Points needed: gun Zones 4-6 required 1+ point (0% success at 0 points); bow drew nobody at 0 points in any zone and Zones 4-6 required 5+ points.

The agency publishes how many winners had each point count, not applicants at each level. Everyone above the lowest winning level is assumed to have drawn, and all remaining applicants are counted at that lowest level.
